# Original VoxelCraft trial chambers (v0.16 Track C). Pool names, weights and
# connector names/targets follow Java 26.3's trial_chambers template pools;
# the geometry is original and the catalogue reduced. Generated by hand-kept
# rules: 3-wide, 4-high doorways centred on every connector. Decorated pot
# positions are plain chiseled tuff until pots exist. Spawner names are
# trial:<alias>, resolved per structure like Java's pool aliases.

template trial_chambers/corridor/end_1
size 15 11 15
projection rigid
fill 0 0 0 14 10 14 tuff_bricks
fill 0 0 0 14 0 14 polished_tuff
fill 0 10 0 14 10 14 tuff_bricks
fill 1 1 1 13 9 13 air
fill 5 0 5 9 0 9 chiseled_tuff
fill 6 0 6 8 0 8 waxed_chiseled_copper
fill 3 10 3 11 10 11 waxed_copper_grate
fill 6 1 0 8 4 0 air
fill 6 1 14 8 4 14 air
jigsaw 7 1 0 north empty second_corridor trial_chambers/corridor
jigsaw 7 1 14 south empty in_connector trial_chambers/chambers/end
fill 10 0 11 12 0 13 waxed_oxidized_cut_copper
put 11 1 12 ominous_vault@north
put 3 1 12 vault@north
put 1 1 3 chest:trial_chambers/supply@east
put 13 1 3 chiseled_tuff
put 0 5 7 waxed_copper_bulb
put 14 5 7 waxed_copper_bulb
put 7 5 0 waxed_copper_bulb
put 7 5 14 waxed_copper_bulb
end
